question: For veg whsle data, can you analyze our financial performance over the years 2020 to 2023? I need insights into the average wholesale price, maximum wholesale price, minimum wholesale price, wholesale price difference, total wholesale price, total selling price, average loss rate, total loss, and profit for each category within each year. Round all calculated values to two decimal places.
sql:
WITH wholesale_with_loss AS (
    SELECT 
        CAST(SUBSTR(w.whsle_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) as year,
        c.category_name,
        SUM(w."whsle_px_rmb-kg") as total_wholesale_price,
        AVG(w."whsle_px_rmb-kg") as avg_wholesale_price,
        MAX(w."whsle_px_rmb-kg") as max_wholesale_price,
        MIN(w."whsle_px_rmb-kg") as min_wholesale_price,
        SUM(w."whsle_px_rmb-kg" * l."loss_rate_%") / 100.0 as total_loss
    FROM veg_whsle_df w
    JOIN veg_cat c ON w.item_code = c.item_code
    JOIN veg_loss_rate_df l ON w.item_code = l.item_code
    WHERE CAST(SUBSTR(w.whsle_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 2020 AND 2023
    GROUP BY year, c.category_name
),
selling_data AS (
    SELECT 
        CAST(SUBSTR(t.txn_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) as year,
        c.category_name,
        SUM(t."qty_sold(kg)" * t."unit_selling_px_rmb/kg") as total_selling_price
    FROM veg_txn_df t
    JOIN veg_cat c ON t.item_code = c.item_code
    WHERE CAST(SUBSTR(t.txn_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 2020 AND 2023
    GROUP BY year, c.category_name
),
avg_loss_rate AS (
    SELECT 
        c.category_name,
        AVG(l."loss_rate_%") as avg_loss_rate
    FROM veg_cat c
    JOIN veg_loss_rate_df l ON c.item_code = l.item_code
    GROUP BY c.category_name
)
SELECT 
    wwl.year,
    wwl.category_name,
    ROUND(wwl.avg_wholesale_price, 2) as average_wholesale_price,
    ROUND(wwl.max_wholesale_price, 2) as maximum_wholesale_price,
    ROUND(wwl.min_wholesale_price, 2) as minimum_wholesale_price,
    ROUND(wwl.max_wholesale_price - wwl.min_wholesale_price, 2) as wholesale_price_difference,
    ROUND(wwl.total_wholesale_price, 2) as total_wholesale_price,
    ROUND(sd.total_selling_price, 2) as total_selling_price,
    ROUND(alr.avg_loss_rate, 2) as average_loss_rate,
    ROUND(wwl.total_loss, 2) as total_loss,
    ROUND(sd.total_selling_price - wwl.total_wholesale_price, 2) as profit
FROM wholesale_with_loss wwl
JOIN selling_data sd ON wwl.year = sd.year AND wwl.category_name = sd.category_name
JOIN avg_loss_rate alr ON wwl.category_name = alr.category_name
ORDER BY wwl.year, wwl.category_name
